A Harvard neuroscientist... denied a promotion... and a conference room massacre.

On a quiet Friday in 2010... Amy Bishop walked into a faculty meeting at the University of Alabama. Forty-five minutes later... she did something horrific. But this wasn’t a random act of violence... it was years in the making.

Because when investigators started digging, they uncovered a chilling past: a dead brother, missing police records, unsolved bomb plots, and rage that had been bubbling just below the surface for decades.

Who was Amy Bishop really... brilliant professor or ticking time bomb? And how did she get away with so much for so long? There were red flags fricken EVERYWHERE.

comments.text:
I knew Amy Bishop and had briefly spoken to her multiple times when I'd go to work with my mom. I remember that I always felt a strange sense of unease and intensity coming from her. She was somehow more socially awkward and moody than I was, being a 12-13 year old middle schooler. She also seemed to have the personality of a rusty, gunk-filled brillo pad. 

She was shallowly professional when it counted... At least until she was crossed. Upon unfortunately reaching that part of the nose diving conversation; she'd be the type where you'd need a metaphysical shop's worth of sage and crystals - as well as a couple of lunchtime strawberry mojitos to realign your chakras. (Many lunch dates with my mom were spent with her doing just that. 😂)

Amy had a bad habit of looming and pacing. She'd often be found loitering in front of offices, waiting for specific people of whom would be the current target of her intended "check-in" routine. Only... she'd do this multiple times a day EVERY DAY to check on the progress of a certain task or favor that was asked of that admin coworker. This was ESPECIALLY the case when it came to discussions concerning her grant proposal status. She had a set daily routine to harass coworkers of the admin department in an effort to try and "expedite" any and all paper work of hers. I'm pretty sure my Mom would've been on that hit list for that since she was an accountant. Especially since my fiery tempered Mom was also the one to process the grant proposals for budgeting purposes. Everyone in the office...Tolerated her in very small doses, often inspiring intense venting sessions of office gossip. She could either be sheepishly cordial and objectively "professional" or just mouthy and pushy. -- I'd only ever seen my Mom smoke a cigarette once in my life and it was after having a falling out with her. Yea...It was kind of a roll of the D20 for a saving throw there. 😅🤷‍♀️
